gameplayPillars.title: Explore without a fixed path
gameplayPillars.description: Ride Torrent across enormous connected regions, discover caves, castles, catacombs and hidden questlines.

gameplayPillars.title: Build your Tarnished
gameplayPillars.description: Mix weapons, Ashes of War, sorceries, incantations, armor, summons and attributes into highly distinct builds.

gameplayPillars.title: Learn and overcome
gameplayPillars.description: Bosses reward observation, timing, positioning and preparation, with co-op and Spirit Ashes available when extra help is needed.

worldSummary: The Lands Between is a decaying mythic realm shaped by the Shattering of the Elden Ring. Open fields connect seamlessly to legacy dungeons, underground regions and the Realm of Shadow, with environmental storytelling and optional discoveries forming much of the narrative.

storyChapters.title: The Shattering
storyChapters.body: The Elden Ring is broken and demigods claim its Great Runes, plunging the Lands Between into war.

storyChapters.title: The Tarnished Returns
storyChapters.body: Guided by Grace, an exiled Tarnished returns to gather Great Runes and pursue the title of Elden Lord.

storyChapters.title: Realm of Shadow
storyChapters.body: Shadow of the Erdtree follows Miquella's path into a separate land filled with new factions, dungeons and major bosses.

faq.q: Does Tarnished Edition include Shadow of the Erdtree?
faq.a: Yes. The Switch 2 Tarnished Edition includes the original ELDEN RING and the full Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.
Nintendo lists approximately 40.9 GB of required space; physical copies also require download space.
Yes. Nintendo lists 1–6 online players; paid Nintendo Switch Online is required for online modes.

verdictSummary: An unusually complete package of one of the defining open-world action RPGs of its generation. The Switch 2 edition trades performance headroom for portability, but includes the huge base adventure and its major expansion.

reviews.quote: The base game's PS5 aggregate remains one of the highest of its generation.
